youtube.caption:
The ancient Olympics had no uniforms. At all 🫒

Would YOU run naked for a crown of leaves? Yes or no 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: athletes at the ancient Greek Olympics competed nude, rubbed down with olive oil, in front of crowds of tens of thousands at Olympia. The winner's prize was a kotinos, a crown of wild olive leaves.
